kirana.name: Kirana
kirana.voice: a warm, clear female lead vocalist

sections.label: Intro
sections.note: instrumental: a solo trumpet plays the chorus melody over Rhodes piano, like a bugle call at dusk

lines.en: I fell at the edge of dusk
into a quiet valley with no name

lines.id: Kau angkat cahaya yang hampir padam
lines.en: You lifted a light that had almost died
and carried it home in your hands
You blow your bugle from the tower
and wake the morning for the town
But every day my light grows faint

lines.id: Bintang tak bisa lama tinggal di sini
lines.en: A star cannot stay here long
Don't cry, my brave one
Take me up to the highest peak

lines.id: Bawa aku pulang ke langit senja
lines.en: Take me home to the twilight sky

lines.id: Walau esok kita tak lagi bersama
lines.zh: 哪怕明天我们不再相守
lines.en: even if tomorrow we are no longer together

lines.zh: 当暮色降临，吹响你的号角
lines.en: Blow your bugle when the evening comes

lines.zh: 我就是那颗回应你名字的星
lines.en: I am the star that answers to your name
The storm comes down on the mountain road
Shadow wolves close in around us
You stand tall in front of me

lines.id: Dengan lagu yang tak pernah ragu
lines.en: with a song that never wavers

lines.id: Di puncak dunia kau lepas tanganku
lines.zh: 在世界之巅，你松开我的手
lines.en: At the top of the world you let go of my hand

lines.id: Air matamu jatuh jadi hujan cahaya
lines.zh: 你的泪落下，化作光之雨
lines.en: Your tears fall and turn to rain of light
Don't forget me
I will never be far

sections.label: Trumpet Solo
sections.note: instrumental: a long, soaring trumpet solo over the full band, building to the key change

sections.label: Final Chorus
sections.note: up a whole step, a choir joins

extra.zh: 我就是那颗回应你名字的星
extra.en: I am the star that answers to your name

sections.label: Outro
sections.note: soft, a muted trumpet echoes the chorus melody

lines.en: Every dusk, I am there

about: A star falls at twilight. A young bugler carries her back to the sky.
